title: Agua de Estrellas
about: A Spanish-language water blessing — its “Limpia limpia, limpia corazón” bridge is how many circles name the song. Printed in Songs of Light p.147 and Mantra-Sammlung Rafael p.72 among roughly fifteen books of the collection; authorship is sometimes credited to Miguel Molina. The melody here follows the singing on The White Arrow — Limpia corazón.
